member.name: OdooConfig
member.summary: Connection settings of an Odoo server: url, database, credentials, timeout and default . Clients created with equal url, database and user name share one login.

member.name: ApiUrl
member.summary: Odoo server url without trailing slash, e.g. https://my-company.odoo.com.

member.name: Password
member.summary: Password or API key of the Odoo user. An API key is recommended (Odoo user preferences - Account Security).

member.name: Timeout
member.summary: Timeout of a single request. Default (zero) means 100 seconds.

member.name: Context
member.summary: Default Odoo context sent with requests (language, timezone, company...). Used when a method is called without its own context; can be changed after creating the config.

member.name: ctor
member.summary: Creates settings with empty context (Odoo uses the user's language and company).
member.param: Odoo server url, e.g. https://my-company.odoo.com; trailing slash is removed.
Odoo database name.
Login of the Odoo user.
Password or API key of the Odoo user.
Timeout of a single request; default (zero) means 100 seconds.
External API used for requests; default JSON-RPC, for Odoo 19+ with an API key as .

member.name: ctor.Language
member.summary: Creates settings with default language - translatable fields are returned in this language.
member.param: Odoo server url, e.g. https://my-company.odoo.com; trailing slash is removed.
Odoo database name.
Login of the Odoo user.
Password or API key of the Odoo user.
Odoo language code, e.g. en_US, pl_PL; the language must be installed in Odoo.
Timeout of a single request; default (zero) means 100 seconds.
External API used for requests; default JSON-RPC, for Odoo 19+ with an API key as .
